proposed.explanation: Ethics extend beyond technical competence to honesty and responsibility. Client satisfaction cannot override professional standards or public welfare. Cost constraints cannot justify compromising safety or quality. Professional ethics include integrity (honest representation of capabilities and performance), competence (designing within one's knowledge or engaging qualified consultants), duty to client (faithful representation of interests), and duty to public (ensuring safety, code compliance, and no environmental or community harm).
